page.notes: Blue ink lines and marks over the printed text are overlay annotations and were ignored. Hebrew words are copied from the scan: זקנים, תורגמן, תלמיד חכם. The Hebrew in the first and third entries is printed in a boxed or bracketed form and is copied as read. The word "Hebraïs" in the last entry is read from a small scan and may be "Hebraeis" [?].
